verdict.rationale: Elicit documents its own background automations. Alerts monitor continuously and email you when new relevant papers appear. Routines, mentioned only on a legacy Alerts page, can act on what they find: filter on richer criteria, update an artifact, or write a summary. The API supports automated reports from your own scripts, but that is a developer building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation on setting up Routines, how they are scheduled or triggered, the range of actions they can take, and hands-on corroboration that they run unattended.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: A Routine can act on what it finds and hand you a finished analysis: it can filter on criteria an Alert couldn't, update an artifact, or write the summary
Turn on **Instant email alerts** to be immediately alerted whenever a new relevant research paper is found.
Alerts keep you up to date on the latest research about topics that are relevant to you, ready to add to your Library for future use.
